about.intro.title: Hey 👋!
about.intro.message: I’m Yuchen 🍊, a results-driven software engineer with 4 years of experience building scalable web and mobile applications, based in Singapore. I specialize in clean, interactive frontend experiences 💻 and integrating AI-powered tools into product and engineering workflows to drive automation and smarter decision-making. Outside of work, I travel ✈️, enjoy food 🍝, and play music 🎹. Thanks for visiting! 🧡
